title: dialogue
description: Opens NPC dialogue for a player. See the page on the [Dialogue documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/minecraft/creator/documents/npcdialogue#dialogue-command) for more information.

npc.title: npc
npc.description: Required. The target for the NPC menu. Must be a [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) for an entity with type NPC.

player.title: player
player.description: Target to display menu. A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

scenename.title: sceneName
scenename.description: A `string` that specifies the scene file to run from the behavior pack.

players.title: players
players.description: Target to display menu. A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.
